scope: ready lodging deep research reinforcement: dogo-kotononiwa / 道後温泉 葛城 琴の庭
method: Existing Rakuten, Jalan, Ikkyu, and Yahoo ecosystem direct counts were retained with Yahoo Travel/Yahoo Maps separated after recheck. Google Maps/Hotels was rechecked with Aside Browser and the earlier Google-native 16-review line was replaced by a longer author-card recount. 4travel hotel reviews, 4travel travelogues, Japanese blogs, note posts, and Lemon8 direct stay bodies were added. A later Aside Browser pass changed Agoda from blocked to partial direct-readable, added low-weight Tabelog lodging/meal review bodies and two usable YouTube transcript bodies. Booking, Trip.com, Tripadvisor sibling/identity-mixed surfaces, Hotels.com/Expedia, Naver, AI summaries, search snippets, and OTA summaries were excluded from direct review counts unless individual body text was readable and identity-clean.

direct_review_sampling_status.why_not_300: Additional direct bodies increased the sample from 184 to 271. Google visible pool is 94, but only 55 body-bearing Google-native author cards were counted after Aside Browser long-scroll recount; rating-only/no-body cards and provider cards were excluded. Yahoo/Ikkyu combined modal was loaded to 91 direct bodies but matched the already-counted Ikkyu 70 + Yahoo Travel 21 pool, so it added 0 unique direct bodies. Agoda exposed 4 usable visible bodies out of a 12-review Agoda tab even after scroll, sort, language, traveler-type, and keyword-chip checks; Tabelog added 12 low-weight lodging/meal bodies; YouTube added 3 usable transcript bodies; and two additional note stay bodies were counted. Booking exact target was not found, Trip.com has no reviews, Tripadvisor remains identity-mixed, and Naver did not expose a clean Korean firsthand stay review.
direct_review_sampling_status.next_to_A: Need at least 29 additional direct review bodies. Priority: re-open Google-native for any hidden body-bearing cards and find additional exact first-person Japanese/Korean stay blogs. Only count more YouTube/Vlog sources if transcript text is readable rather than title/description/visual-only. Agoda should be treated as partially exhausted in Aside: 12-review tab visible, but only four individual body cards rendered.

google_maps.access_note: Aside Browser opened Google Maps review tab and long-scrolled the Google-native author cards. This 55/39 recount replaces the earlier 16/14 Google line. Rating-only/no-body cards and Google provider/OTA cards were not counted.

ota_review_pool_signals.note: Current surface still exposes 71 reviews; existing latest/archive direct count retained.
Rechecked with Aside Browser. Yahoo headline 84 is a Yahoo Travel + Ikkyu combined score surface; the Yahoo Travel review page itself exposes 21 unique Yahoo Travel bodies.
Four Yahoo!地図 visitor-review cards appear at the bottom of the Yahoo Travel review page. Counted separately from Yahoo Travel lodging reviews.

ota_review_pool_signals.notes: Aside loaded the combined modal to 91 body records with hasNextPage=false. This validates the already-counted Ikkyu 70 + Yahoo Travel 21 pool and adds 0 unique direct bodies.
Trip.com page says 'Be the first to post a review after your stay'; property description is official/OTA facility text only.

One Kotononiwa-labeled review body was readable and mentions source-flow onsen, but the page chrome/header points to Hotel Katsuragi Spa Resort Dogo. Kept as identity-mixed and not counted in direct totals. The separate Hotel Katsuragi Spa Resort Dogo page with 110 reviews is excluded.

Aside Browser review section showed Agoda-native tab 12 reviews plus 1 other-site tab. Four Agoda-native visible body cards were read; one directly mentioned private room onsen. Other-site card was not counted. A later Aside recheck tried panel scroll-to-bottom, newest/high/low/helpful sort, Japanese and Traditional Chinese language filters, traveler-type filters, and keyword chips (spa/room comfort/service); no more than the same four body cards rendered.

Tabelog is a food/meal review surface rather than a lodging OTA. Counted conservatively as low-weight direct bodies because the page exposes individual author review text tied to this exact property; repeated same-author visits remain lower weight for source_count. Bath mentions include 客室露天風呂, 半露天風呂, 源泉掛け流し, and room-bath cold-season usability.

Several exact Kotononiwa stay videos were found, but only transcript text was eligible. Three Japanese auto-generated transcripts were readable enough for direct bath text; title-only/video-only results, description-only bath claims, and noisy music/filler captions were not counted.
Aside Browser/search did not surface an exact Kotononiwa Booking.com listing. Sibling Dogo-no-Yado Katsuragi results were excluded.
Korean Naver queries mostly surfaced ads, OTA/official pages, noisy hits, or one agency/recommendation-style Naver Blog page. No clean Korean firsthand stay review body was counted.

lodgings.next_sampling: A급으로 올리려면 추가 29건 이상이 필요하다. Yahoo/Ikkyu 결합 모달은 Aside로 91건 끝까지 확인했지만 중복 풀이라 추가 0건이었다. Agoda는 12건 탭 중 4건 본문만 렌더되는 상태를 Aside로 재확인했다. 남은 우선순위는 Google-native rating-only/no-body 카드 외 추가 본문 확장, 한국어 직접 숙박기 재검색, 자막이 읽히는 정확 숙소 YouTube/Vlog 텍스트 보강이다.
